about: Tests deleted or skipped on dev without a PR body to list them (DEL-36, DEL-81): each with its reason and the commit that retired it. The release run's retired-tests step reads this file with the commits' own ## Retired tests sections.

tests.reason: Raw HTML never renders now: tags are removed with a security.html warning, so a raw cannot reach the report folder check; the hostile corpus covers raw HTML in every sink.
The ignored test is `dump`, a manual helper that prints each case's findings for writing the corpus index; it checks nothing.

tests.test: tools/rv-gate/test/gate.test.mjs::the pre-push hook refuses prod, dev, main and candidate pushes unless the gate marks them
tests.reason: Renamed for DEL-81: the same test now says the hook lets agents push dev and refuses pre-prod, prod, main and candidates.

Renamed to title_image_audio_video_and_sandboxed_embeds_are_supported: `prolog` is dropped from the format (FEA-RP-05), so the test no longer sets or asserts it; its title image, audio, video and sandboxed embed assertions are unchanged. Prolog's absence from the output is asserted in tests/shell.rs::description_feeds_the_deck_and_the_preview_tags_and_nothing_else_does.

The `data-theme` attribute, the in-report `Render report card` and the `prolog` markup are gone from report HTML (FEA-RP-31, 33, 05); compatibility_export_..., reports_without_tabs_... and pdf_output_... now assert their absence, and the font-notice test asserts one notice per face the style embeds (FEA-RP-38).

Renamed strict_semver_versions_publish_and_resolve_without_path_escape: leading-zero and padded versions are invalid under TYP-62's strict SemVer, so the test publishes strict versions and still checks path escape.
Renamed storage_keeps_every_version_and_concurrent_publication_is_idempotent: TYP-64 removes the 50-version pruning, so the test asserts every version is kept; concurrent idempotence is unchanged.

The behaviour is removed by FEA-BR-30: metric_strips and the dashboard layout are gone with kind: dashboard.
The behaviour is removed by FEA-BR-30: a dashboard kind is now refused, covered by a_dashboard_kind_or_snapshot_is_refused_because_publish_has_reports_and_pages_only.
The behaviour is removed by FEA-BR-30: the dashboard snapshot builder and the example-trading-desk item it built are gone.

The binary embeds the report runtime (ARC-07) and the richview-server binary and --public-dir are gone, so there are no packaged assets to find; the editor LSP test and native_contract cover generate, MCP and serve.
RICHVIEW_PUBLIC_DIR and --public-dir no longer exist (ARC-07), so there is no precedence to keep.
The report host no longer serves the site or redirects to therichview.com (the site is its own host); replaced by the_report_host_serves_reports_only.
The report host serves no static runtime files now; the runtime is embedded in each report.
Directory index and the public-origin static routes left the report host; publishing over HTTP is covered by identity.rs.
The report host no longer serves the precompressed runtime file.
Moved unchanged to crates/richview-editor/tests/snippets.rs: main.rs is now the LSP entry point.
Replaced by crates/richview-editor/tests/lsp.rs::preview_renders_the_open_text_and_unsaved_documents_get_a_save_message; publish needs a server and token (richview/publish).
Moved to crates/richview-editor/tests/lsp.rs::the_trusted_editor_runtime_is_external_only_for_preview, which keeps the runtime URL assertions over real LSP.
`prolog` leaves the format (FEA-RP-05), so frontmatter prolog Markdown is no longer a sink; the same Markdown sanitising is exercised by the body and callout cases of the corpus.

Tabs stack every panel under its label until the runtime builds the tab row (FEA-BR-09): the tests tabs_split_..., tabs_without_a_runtime_..., tabs_export_active_... and invalid_tabs_... now assert the static panel markup and the print rules instead of server-built nav buttons, `hidden` panels and the noscript style.

A rich fence that fails shows a notice with its source (FEA-RP-29) and is kept in Document.failed instead of staying in the body as a code block; commonmark/provenance, schema-diagnostics, unsplash and header_and_unresolved_data tests assert the notice, `failed` and the per-block data failure (FEA-RP-30) instead of fenced code and a whole-render error.
Wikilinks are dropped (FEA-RP-12, assumed: drop): [[Target|label]] renders as its label and warns markdown.wikilink; tests/markdown_ext.rs covers it.
FEA-RP-30: a remote Markdown image no longer stops the render; replaced by a_remote_markdown_image_fails_alone_and_its_alt_text_stays.
Renamed to the_source_key_controls_numeric_text_semantics_and_json_strings_stay_text: it fed JSON content through a csv: key, which TYP-92 refuses.
